techniques.name: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC)
techniques.goal: Learn new tasks while reducing catastrophic forgetting
techniques.mechanism: Penalize changes to parameters estimated important for prior tasks using Fisher-information-weighted quadratic regularization.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: External skills/memory remain preferred before continual weight updates.
avoid_when: Application-level memory/skills can handle adaptation more transparently

techniques.name: Gradient Episodic Memory (GEM)
techniques.goal: Prevent new updates from increasing loss on remembered prior examples
techniques.mechanism: Maintain episodic exemplars and project gradient so it does not interfere with previous-task constraints.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS analogue is regression replay before promotion.
use_when: Local continual learner with bounded exemplar storage
avoid_when: Sensitive historical samples cannot be retained

techniques.name: Learning without Forgetting (LwF)
techniques.goal: Retain old behavior without old training data
techniques.mechanism: Use old model predictions as distillation targets while training new task examples.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Versioned model behavior can become a regression teacher only when explicitly desired.
avoid_when: Old model already contains undesirable behavior

techniques.name: Replay/rehearsal continual learning
techniques.goal: Reduce forgetting by interleaving representative prior examples during new learning
techniques.mechanism: Maintain or regenerate replay buffer from prior tasks and mix it into updates.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: At Agent OS level, historical task replay is safer and more auditable.
avoid_when: Private examples cannot be retained/generated safely

techniques.name: Adapter-per-domain continual adaptation
techniques.goal: Avoid destructive interference by separating domain adaptations
techniques.mechanism: Keep shared base frozen and maintain independently versioned LoRA/adapter modules per domain/task, route at inference.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Matches Agent OS domain-boundary philosophy better than one continually mutating personal model.
use_when: Local models with clearly separated work/personal/specialist domains

techniques.name: Concept-drift detection
techniques.goal: Detect when historical performance assumptions no longer hold
techniques.mechanism: Monitor input/features/errors/outcomes over time and trigger review when statistically relevant change occurs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Trigger re-eval, not automatic retraining.
risks: Data drift need not imply performance drift

techniques.name: Adaptive-window drift monitoring (ADWIN-style)
techniques.goal: Adapt monitoring time horizon automatically to change rate
techniques.mechanism: Compare subwindows and shrink historical window when statistically significant mean change is detected.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Candidate for acceptance/dismissal/proactive precision trends.

techniques.name: Performance-drift before data-drift prioritization
techniques.goal: Avoid costly retraining just because inputs changed
techniques.mechanism: Prioritize direct task/quality metrics; use distribution changes as diagnostic unless they are known leading indicators.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Research Radar/re-eval cadence responds to meaningful outcome change.
required_evals: alerts that led to meaningful degradation
risks: Delayed outcome can miss early harm

techniques.name: Training-serving skew checks
techniques.goal: Ensure model/evaluator sees equivalent features and preprocessing offline and online
techniques.mechanism: Share feature/preprocessing code or continuously compare training/eval and production feature distributions/semantics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Capability evidence is invalid if eval pipeline differs from production.

techniques.name: Simple heuristic baseline
techniques.goal: Prove a learned/agentic method beats a cheap understandable alternative
techniques.mechanism: Implement recency/rules/BM25/threshold/simple classifier baseline before complex ML where feasible.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every Meta-Improvement experiment names simplest credible alternative.
risks: Baseline can become entrenched complex heuristic

techniques.name: Contextual bandit personalization
techniques.goal: Adapt choices to context from partial user feedback while balancing exploration/exploitation
techniques.mechanism: Treat intervention/content/action choice as bandit arm conditioned on context; update from observed reward.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only optimize reversible presentation choices first.

techniques.name: Thompson sampling
techniques.goal: Explore uncertain alternatives in proportion to posterior plausibility
techniques.mechanism: Maintain posterior beliefs over action rewards and sample a plausible parameter/model to choose each action.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use conservative priors and explicit risk constraints.

techniques.name: Constrained/safe contextual bandits
techniques.goal: Allow online adaptation without violating safety/quality floors
techniques.mechanism: Optimize reward subject to auxiliary constraints relative to baseline/policy.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Deterministic policy remains hard boundary outside learned optimization.
risks: Statistical constraints are not authorization rules

techniques.name: Offline policy evaluation from logged randomized traffic
techniques.goal: Evaluate candidate bandit/recommender policy without exposing all users to it
techniques.mechanism: Use known propensity of logged actions to estimate counterfactual policy performance.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: If online exploration is ever used, log propensity by design.
use_when: Future proactivity experiments with randomized eligible choices
avoid_when: Historical policy had zero support for candidate actions

techniques.name: Exploration budget / do-not-explore classes
techniques.goal: Prevent personalization experiments from sacrificing user welfare for information
techniques.mechanism: Classify actions by reversibility/risk; exploration allowed only in low-impact choices and capped by rate/time/context.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Never explore purchases, messages, security permissions, or other consequential actions.

techniques.name: Delayed-reward attribution
techniques.goal: Avoid learning wrong lessons from outcomes arriving later than action
techniques.mechanism: Link interventions to later user action/outcome using windows/causal identifiers and distinguish immediate feedback from delayed success.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Preserve intervention IDs through downstream task state.

techniques.name: Feedback-loop isolation
techniques.goal: Prevent model's own choices from corrupting the data used to judge future choices
techniques.mechanism: Keep randomized/control/shadow samples or other independent data sources so model exposure is not confused with underlying preference/demand.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta Engine must know which evidence was influenced by current policy.
avoid_when: System has no behavioral feedback loop

techniques.name: Adaptive holdout protection
techniques.goal: Reuse validation resources without silently overfitting through repeated adaptive queries
techniques.mechanism: Limit/restrict access to protected holdout and use statistically principled mechanisms or fresh data after many adaptive decisions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Optimizers see dev suite; promotion service owns holdout.

techniques.name: Differentially private training
techniques.goal: Bound influence of any individual's training record
techniques.mechanism: Clip per-example/user gradients and add calibrated noise while accounting privacy loss across training.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Personal single-user context should usually stay local rather than be 'anonymized' into shared training.
use_when: Future aggregate personalization model trained on many people's sensitive data
avoid_when: Single-user local Agent OS where data never leaves device

techniques.name: Privacy-budget accounting and composition
techniques.goal: Prevent many individually private analyses from accumulating unacceptable leakage
techniques.mechanism: Track epsilon/delta and composition across releases/training/queries; stop/adjust when budget exhausted.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: DP claims require exact mechanism/accountant provenance.

techniques.name: Federated learning / FedAvg
techniques.goal: Train shared model while leaving raw training examples on client devices
techniques.mechanism: Clients perform local SGD and server aggregates model updates, reducing raw-data centralization.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Do not equate federated with private; combine with secure aggregation/DP as needed.
avoid_when: Need strong privacy guarantee—federated alone is insufficient

techniques.name: Secure aggregation
techniques.goal: Hide individual client model updates from aggregation server
techniques.mechanism: Cryptographically compute aggregate of client updates while server cannot inspect individual contributions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only relevant if Agent OS becomes multi-user platform.
avoid_when: Small participant count unsuitable for anonymity assumptions
risks: Does not protect final aggregate/model from all leakage

techniques.name: Local-first state with CRDT merge
techniques.goal: Keep device-local autonomy/offline writes while merging concurrent replicated state predictably
techniques.mechanism: Represent selected state with convergent/commutative replicated data types and causal metadata.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use for queues/counters/sets where merge semantics are mathematically clear, not all knowledge.
avoid_when: Canonical reviewed Git artifacts where human merge is desired
Sensitive data not meant to replicate
risks: CRDT semantics may be wrong for business meaning

techniques.name: Explicit data dependency ownership
techniques.goal: Prevent invisible upstream changes from breaking learned behavior
techniques.mechanism: Each feature/source/index declares owner, schema/version, freshness SLA, consumers and invalidation semantics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Generated component graph should expose undeclared dependencies.

techniques.name: Undeclared-consumer detection
techniques.goal: Know who depends on a model/tool/schema before changing or deleting it
techniques.mechanism: Instrument reads/calls and compare observed consumers against declared component graph.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Deletion candidate requires declared + observed consumer audit.
risks: Rare offline consumer may not appear in sample window

techniques.name: Configuration-as-code with validation
techniques.goal: Reduce configuration debt and irreproducible behavior
techniques.mechanism: Version configuration, define schemas/invariants, generate diffs and test configs in CI/evals before activation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every behavioral knob has owner/default/rationale/expiry or review date.
risks: Configuration surface can still grow excessively

techniques.name: Anti-entanglement feature/component boundaries
techniques.goal: Limit CACE-style ripple effects where one input/component changes everything
techniques.mechanism: Prefer narrow contracts, modular features, explicit dependencies, and avoid unnecessary coupling/shared mutable state.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta simplifier tracks fan-in/fan-out and change blast radius.

techniques.name: Long-term user objective over immediate engagement proxy
techniques.goal: Prevent optimizer from gaming clicks/acceptance while harming real usefulness
techniques.mechanism: Choose primary metrics tied to sustained task success/user burden and use short-term interaction metrics only as diagnostics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Never optimize notification click/acceptance alone.
risks: Long-term outcomes are hard to attribute

techniques.name: Complexity tax in objective
techniques.goal: Make marginal accuracy improvements compete against maintenance/system cost
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate candidate change on quality plus code/config/state/dependency/latency/cost surface rather than metric gain alone.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: A tiny quality gain can be rejected if it creates permanent architecture debt.

techniques.name: Revalidate after external-world change
techniques.goal: Keep old benchmark conclusions from becoming permanent defaults
techniques.mechanism: Tie models/tools/dependencies/policies to freshness and automatically reopen relevant evals after version/API/data-distribution changes.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Research Radar emits invalidation events against CAP/EVR records.
risks: Too many revalidations if dependency graph broad
